claims.claim: The pure Reviewer request constructor and revalidator bind a SEMANTIC_REVIEW DecisionPacket, P1A/P1B/P2A/P2B packages, exact prior REVIEW context, external identities, and a deterministic request fingerprint.

The protocol validates a bounded provider response, delegates semantic grammar to P2B, binds REVIEW identities outside provider authorship, rejects canonical parsing drift, calls review.validate_review, and produces a fingerprinted transient decision with pure revalidation.

Focused tests cover PRIMARY and DELTA decisions, all 32 finding slots, substitution and fingerprint failures, strict JSON bounds, canonical text handling, and absence of provider or lifecycle authority imports; 16 focused tests passed locally.
